hero.title: Your job contract, through the eyes of the law.
hero.description: Share your contract. In minutes, see where the risks are, which sections of the law they conflict with, and what to ask to change. Every legal citation is checked against the official source.
hero.scope: No guesswork. If we cannot verify it, we say: uncertain.
hero.sceneAlt: A floating glass contract: an emerald seal on a verified clause, and a broken red glass fragment.

trust.label: What we promise
trust.noInventedLaw: A made-up section is never shown
trust.officialLink: An official-source link with every citation

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: From the words of the contract to a verified official source: clear and private at every step.
howItWorks.uploadBody: A PDF, photos or text. A camera photo is fine.
howItWorks.privacyBody: Names, addresses, phone and national ID numbers are removed on our server, then the analysis starts.
howItWorks.reviewBody: Every clause is checked against the law corpus.
howItWorks.verifyBody: A citation is shown only after three checks: the section exists, the quoted words match, and the section supports the claim.

comparison.title: Made-up sections stop here.
comparison.description: A plain AI can name a section number that is not in the law. We check every citation against the law corpus; one that does not match is rejected.

audience.title: For everyone in a working relationship.
audience.workersBody: Understand your contract terms and find the legal sources of your rights.
audience.hrBody: Check the language of employment contracts and your own policies.
audience.ngoBody: Review what could not be verified, and see usage and cost.

limits.title: We say what we know, and what we do not.
limits.uncertain: If something is uncertain, we say so
limits.description: This tool helps you understand a contract; it does not replace a lawyer. A claim that cannot be checked against an official source is never shown as certain.
